title: Swight short sword
description: Spawnplayer/swight short sword more visibility featured in swight/spawnplayer videos
body:
This resource pack replaces the standard Minecraft sword model and texture with the Swight Short Sword, as seen in Swight's latest videos.
Key Features:
 Custom Model & Texture: Replaces the default sword texture with a custom design inspired by Swight’s content.
 Visual Aesthetics: Features a unique visual style designed for high contrast and clear tracking during gameplay.
 Vanilla Compatibility: Designed to maintain consistent performance with the vanilla game while providing a fresh look for your equipment.
Requirements:
 This is a resource pack, not a mod. It does not change gameplay mechanics, damage values, or attack speeds.![Sword showcase](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cf7c3a8e97390b68f3f1a5cb9efb64b1c30ebad6.jpeg)
